facebook.caption: Tourists keep walking past this. The Cao Dai Temple on Đường Nguyễn Trãi is one of the most visually striking buildings in Phu Quoc. Free to enter. Dress modestly. The architecture alone is worth the detour. Most visitors never leave the beach strip, so you'll likely have it almost to yourself. Add it to your day before the heat kicks in. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
facebook.video_caption: Walking into the Cao Dai Temple in Phu Quoc. Zero crowds, zero entry fee. The colors hit different in person. This is what most tourists miss while sticking to the resort zones.
